# OntoLogos v0.4.0

OWL RL forward-chaining on top of RDFS, with full ABox support in `ontologos-core`.

```toml
ontologos-core = "0.4.0"
ontologos-parser = "0.4.0"
ontologos-profile = "0.4.0"
ontologos-rdfs = "0.4.0"
ontologos-rl = "0.4.0"
```

- https://docs.rs/ontologos-core/0.4.0
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-rl/0.4.0

## Highlights

- `RlEngine::saturate` — RDFS materialization then OWL RL rule batches until fixed point
- ABox axioms in core + parser (class/property assertions, same/different, equivalent properties)
- `ontologos_rl::classify_reasoner` for `Profile::Rl`; Python `profile="rl"`
- HermiT `testSubsumption2/3` Tier-A conformance ports

## Example

```rust
use ontologos_core::Ontology;
use ontologos_rl::RlEngine;

let mut ontology = Ontology::builder()
    .class("http://example.org/A")?
    .class("http://example.org/B")?
    .subclass_of("http://example.org/A", "http://example.org/B")?
    .build()?;

let report = RlEngine::new(1).saturate(&mut ontology)?;
println!("inferred {}", report.inferred_total());
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.
